last_result.headline: Q40 tested 45 transition arms across 6 families; the DEPLOYED L1 term is the best of all of them (l1 lam=60 = 12.170, reproducing Q10 exactly). Nested over everything: -1.851, helps 20% of wells, 3-well 5th -5.845 -- gate fails all three. The informative negative is the drift prior (-11.475): a degeneracy control proves the implementation is exact (max|drift-l1|=0.000000 when mu=0), and corr(|mu|,degradation)=+0.796 with 477 DP steps per well shows THE DP INTEGRATES THE TRANSITION TERM -- a per-step directional prior compounds into a median 48 ft pull against a 12 ft RMSE scale. Same failure class as Q13. Both named levers on the alignment line (emission via Q17, transition via Q40) are now measured rather than assumed. No submission.
